title: Vibrant Wood Fired Brazilian Savoy Cabbage Bake
description: This nutty and springy Brazilian dish is perfect for a sick day, featuring savoy cabbage and wood-fired baking in a cataplana vessel, adhering to ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a cataplana vessel, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped savoy cabbage and cook until it starts to soften.
Stir in the chopped cashews, salt, black pepper, and turmeric.
Transfer the cataplana vessel to the preheated wood fired oven.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the cabbage is tender.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
